text: This report includes several detailed appendices that provide a full financial summary of all program areas of Exhibition Place for the 1st quarter (Q1) ending March 31, 2024.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (May 22, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (May 22, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place remain confidential as it contains financial information that belongs to the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place and has monetary value or potential monetary value.
